hostname hq-acc-sw-01
!
enable algorithm-type scrypt secret 9 $9$abc$def
username admin privilege 15 algorithm-type scrypt secret 9 $9$abc$def
!
aaa new-model
aaa group server tacacs+ ISE
 server name ISE-1
 server name ISE-2
aaa authentication login default group ISE local
aaa accounting exec default start-stop group ISE
aaa accounting commands 15 default start-stop group ISE
login block-for 900 attempts 3 within 120
!
tacacs server ISE-1
 address ipv4 10.10.20.61
tacacs server ISE-2
 address ipv4 10.10.20.62
!
vlan 10
 name USERS
vlan 30
 name IOT-CAMERAS
!
interface Vlan99
 ip address 10.10.99.11 255.255.255.0
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1
 switchport access vlan 30
 switchport mode access
!
no ip http server
no ip http secure-server
ip ssh version 2
logging host 10.10.20.50
logging host 10.10.20.51
no vstack
snmp-server group NMS v3 priv access MGMT-ONLY
ntp authentication-key 1 hmac-sha2-256 7 0822455D0A16
ntp authenticate
ntp trusted-key 1
ntp server 10.10.20.40 key 1
ntp server 10.10.20.41 key 1
banner login ^C
Authorized access only. Activity is logged.
^C
!
line con 0
 exec-timeout 5 0
line vty 0 15
 access-class MGMT-ONLY in
 exec-timeout 5 0
 transport input ssh
!
